mustFindings.requirement: 1 point per full 1,000 KRW, rounded down
Points expire after 12 months and cannot be redeemed

mustScenarios.risk: Points earned 12 months and one day ago must not be redeemable; today balanceOf sums every entry regardless of age
Paying 1,999 KRW earns 1 point, 999 KRW earns none, 2,000 KRW earns 2
Redeeming more points than the balance is rejected with INSUFFICIENT_POINTS (422) and writes no ledger row
Two redemptions at the same time can both pass the balance check and drive the balance negative
Redeeming exactly the whole balance succeeds and leaves 0
